newsitem.title: USA: Eaton signs joint venture deal in China.
newsitem.headline: Eaton signs joint venture deal in China.

text.p: Eaton Corp said Wednesday that it signed a joint venture agreement with Weihei Measuring Tools Factory in China to manufacture washing machine controls for the Chinese market.
The company said it also established a manufacturing plant in the town of Bielsko Biala, Poland, to supply Fiat and other East European customers with automotive engine valves later this year.

Eaton said the joint venture agreement with Weihei calls for the manufacture of washing machine program timers, water valves and control switches. It said it expects sales from the venture to reach $10 million by the year 2000.
The decision to produce engine valves in Poland is based, in part, on the growing importance of East European automotive manufacturing, the company said.
Eaton said it will invest $5 million in the facility, and expects to employ 150 people when the Polish plant becomes fully operational.
The company said it expects sales from the plant to exceed $20 million by 2000.
